row: Balwyn Sports and Physiotherapy Centre (BSPC) is a highly regarded sports injury clinic in Balwyn, Melbourne. We make a lot of our knowledge available to the public to help improve the quality of people's lives. From strapping and taping techniques for injured joint, to rehab exercises and our very popular pilates + core strength exercise regimes. You can follow along at home, and we hope you like the content, share it with friends and family.
